deploy.mechanism: git push origin claude/ga4-hygiene -> GH Actions auto-merge -> .github/workflows/deploy.yml
deploy.reversibility_note: CF Pages, no atomic revert; named revert = git revert <commit> && git push (same choreography). Machine check per profile-schema: stack=cloudflare-pages -> always prod -> deploy-go granted in advance by Brian's explicit '/ehr-component fully complete the all GA4 items' invocation, validated by brian-gate APPROVE 15/15 this run.

e2e_artifact: negative probe: canary-tokened POST /api/create-checkout returns 200 {ok,url}, NO begin_checkout in GA4 realtime, Stripe session expired within 2 min; positive control: untokened POST produces a GA4 realtime begin_checkout
revert: git revert <merge commit> && git push origin main choreography; GA4 config: retention re-settable, key events re-creatable from pre-delete ledger, annotation deletable
peer_sync_note: gh-pr-merge mechanism; HEAD==origin/main post-merge is the sync assertion
ci: .github/workflows/deploy.yml: Build & Deploy (post-merge; deploy-on-merge repo, CI-gated leg deferred to post-merge per gates.md sec 8)
codename_fence_note: rrm-academy-cf is a public real-terminology site; no codename boundary applies
extra_hard_stops: any edit under functions/api/auth/**, functions/api/billing/**, functions/api/stripe-webhook.js, functions/_middleware.js, wrangler.toml, .github/workflows/**, scripts/guard.mjs, scripts/gates/**, hooks/**
